# DiskMate update manifest (generated by DiskMate.exe --writeversion)
version=1.0.5
url=https://github.com/ankeji/DiskMate/releases/download/v1.0.5/DiskMate.exe
sha256=15EA9544620DEE9923190E459F7A30F2219B4892466CB3BB5A1867784E42F64E
size=1090560
date=2026-11-13
notes.zh=## DiskMate v1.0.5\n\n这次只是把「发版」这件事做对了：编译出两个包，GitHub 上只放生产包。\n\n### 中文\n\n1. `build.bat` 现在一次编译两个包：`DiskMate.exe`（生产，连 `https://c.softinstall.top`）和 `DiskMate-dev.exe`（开发，连本机 `http://127.0.0.1:8099`）。也可以 `build.bat prod` / `build.bat dev` 只编一个\n2. 生产包的后端地址改成编译期写死，**不再读取本机 `settings.ini` 里的 `api.base`**。之前开发调试留下的 `api.base=http://127.0.0.1:8099` 会把线上包也指到本机，这是这次问题的根因\n3. 开发包仍然可以覆盖后端地址，方便连局域网里的测试服\n4. 新增 `--buildinfo` 命令：打印版本、通道（prod/dev）、后端地址，方便确认手里的 exe 是哪个包\n5. GitHub Actions 发版流程改为 `build.bat prod`，并加了一道校验：打出来的包不是 `channel=prod` / `api=https://c.softinstall.top` 就直接构建失败，不再产出 Release\n6. 日志页启动时会多打两行「构建通道 / 账号服务」，出问题时一眼能看出连的是哪个环境\n\n功能上和 v1.0.4 一致（公告弹窗、回收站闪退加固、大文件盘符与删除、功能开关都在）。\n\n### English\n\nThis release only fixes how builds are produced: two packages are compiled, and only the production one goes to GitHub.\n\n1. `build.bat` now builds both packages at once: `DiskMate.exe` (prod, talks to `https://c.softinstall.top`) and `DiskMate-dev.exe` (dev, talks to local `http://127.0.0.1:8099`). `build.bat prod` / `build.bat dev` builds a single one\n2. The prod build's endpoint is fixed at compile time and **no longer reads `api.base` from a local `settings.ini`**. A leftover `api.base=http://127.0.0.1:8099` from debugging used to redirect the production binary to localhost - that was the root cause here\n3. The dev build can still override the endpoint, e.g. to reach a test server on the LAN\n4. New `--buildinfo` command prints version, channel (prod/dev) and endpoint, so you can tell which package you are holding\n5. GitHub Actions now runs `build.bat prod` and fails the build unless the binary reports `channel=prod` / `api=https://c.softinstall.top`, so a mis-built package can never become a Release\n6. The log page prints the build channel and service endpoint on startup\n\nFeature-wise this is identical to v1.0.4 (announcement dialog, Recycle Bin crash hardening, drive picker and deletion in Large Files, feature switches).
notes.en=## DiskMate v1.0.5\n\n这次只是把「发版」这件事做对了：编译出两个包，GitHub 上只放生产包。\n\n### 中文\n\n1. `build.bat` 现在一次编译两个包：`DiskMate.exe`（生产，连 `https://c.softinstall.top`）和 `DiskMate-dev.exe`（开发，连本机 `http://127.0.0.1:8099`）。也可以 `build.bat prod` / `build.bat dev` 只编一个\n2. 生产包的后端地址改成编译期写死，**不再读取本机 `settings.ini` 里的 `api.base`**。之前开发调试留下的 `api.base=http://127.0.0.1:8099` 会把线上包也指到本机，这是这次问题的根因\n3. 开发包仍然可以覆盖后端地址，方便连局域网里的测试服\n4. 新增 `--buildinfo` 命令：打印版本、通道（prod/dev）、后端地址，方便确认手里的 exe 是哪个包\n5. The prod build's endpoint is fixed at compile time and **no longer reads `api.base` from a local `settings.ini`**. A leftover `api.base=http://127.0.0.1:8099` from debugging used to redirect the production binary to localhost - that was the root cause here\n3. The dev build can still override the endpoint, e.g. to reach a test server on the LAN\n4. New `--buildinfo` command prints version, channel (prod/dev) and endpoint, so you can tell which package you are holding\n5. GitHub Actions now runs `build.bat prod` and fails the build unless the binary reports `channel=prod` / `api=https://c.softinstall.top`, so a mis-built package can never become a Release\n6. The log page prints the build channel and service endpoint on startup\n\nFeature-wise this is identical to v1.0.4 (announcement dialog, Recycle Bin crash hardening, drive picker and deletion in Large Files, feature switches).
